segments.source: **Framework**: Accelerate **Kind**: func
Solves a packed triangular system of equations.
segments.ko: Solves a packed triangular system of equations.

segments.source: **Availability**:
iPadOS 16.4+
Mac Catalyst 16.4+
macOS 13.3+
tvOS 16.4+
visionOS 1.0+
watchOS 9.4+
Declaration
Discussion
Solves the system of equations `A*X=B` or `A'*X=B`, depending on the value of `TransA`.
segments.ko: Solves the system of equations `A*X=B` or `A'*X=B`, depending on the value of `TransA`.

segments.source: ❗ **Important**: Apple provides the BLAS and LAPACK libraries under the Accelerate framework to be in line with LAPACK 3.9.1.
segments.ko: ❗ **Important**: Apple provides the BLAS and LAPACK libraries under the Accelerate framework to be in line with LAPACK 3.9.1.

segments.source: Starting with iOS 26, iPadOS 26, macOS 26, tvOS 26, visionOS 26, and watchOS 26, the libraries are in line with LAPACK 3.12.0.
segments.ko: Starting with iOS 26, iPadOS 26, macOS 26, tvOS 26, visionOS 26, and watchOS 26, the libraries are in line with LAPACK 3.12.0.

segments.source: These new interfaces provide additional functionality, as well as a new ILP64 interface.
segments.ko: These new interfaces provide additional functionality, as well as a new ILP64 interface.

segments.source: To use the new interfaces, define `ACCELERATE_NEW_LAPACK` before including the Accelerate or vecLib headers.
segments.ko: To use the new interfaces, define `ACCELERATE_NEW_LAPACK` before including the Accelerate or vecLib headers.

segments.source: For ILP64 interfaces, also define `ACCELERATE_LAPACK_ILP64`.
For Swift projects, specify `ACCELERATE_NEW_LAPACK=1` and `ACCELERATE_LAPACK_ILP64=1` as preprocessor macros in Xcode build settings.
segments.ko: For Swift projects, specify `ACCELERATE_NEW_LAPACK=1` and `ACCELERATE_LAPACK_ILP64=1` as preprocessor macros in Xcode build settings.

segments.source: Parameters
`ORDER`: Specifies row-major (C) or column-major (Fortran) data ordering.
segments.ko: `ORDER`: Specifies row-major (C) or column-major (Fortran) data ordering.

segments.source: `UPLO`: Specifies whether to use the upper or lower triangle from the matrix. Valid values are `'U'` or `'L'`.
segments.ko: `UPLO`: Specifies whether to use the upper or lower triangle from the matrix. Valid values are `'U'` or `'L'`.

segments.source: `TRANSA`: Specifies whether to use matrix A (`'N'` or `'n'`) or the transpose of A (`'T'`, `'t'`, `'C'`, or `'c'`).
segments.ko: `TRANSA`: Specifies whether to use matrix A (`'N'` or `'n'`) or the transpose of A (`'T'`, `'t'`, `'C'`, or `'c'`).

segments.source: `DIAG`: Specifies whether the matrix is unit triangular. Possible values are `'U'` (unit triangular) or `'N'` (not unit triangular).
segments.ko: `DIAG`: Specifies whether the matrix is unit triangular. Possible values are `'U'` (unit triangular) or `'N'` (not unit triangular).

segments.source: `N`: Order of matrix `A`.
`AP`: Matrix `A` (in packed storage format).
`X`: Contains vector `B` on entry. Overwritten with vector `X` on return.
segments.ko: `X`: Contains vector `B` on entry. Overwritten with vector `X` on return.

segments.source: `INCX`: Stride within `X`. For example, if `incX` is 7, every 7th element is used.
segments.ko: `INCX`: Stride within `X`. For example, if `incX` is 7, every 7th element is used.
